credits: 3.0 Credit Hours (Asynchronous Online / Hybrid Active Learning)
description: Comprehensive instruction in production data engineering, high-throughput analytical query engines, vector search pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP) agent integrations, and resilient pipeline orchestration.
learning_outcomes: Design and optimize high-throughput columnar queries using DuckDB and Polars for fast local data transformation.
Implement defensive data quality, schema enforcement, and streaming anomaly detection pipelines.
Process multimodal video and image streams into structured feature stores and vector databases.
Build semantic search, chunking, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge retrieval pipelines.
Architect high-concurrency, asynchronous Data-as-a-Service REST APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic validation.
Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and deterministic tool execution for autonomous AI agents.
Orchestrate resilient event-driven pipelines with scheduled DAGs, retry loops, and telemetry alerting.
Defend an end-to-end data engineering architecture in a live capstone defense addressing cost, latency, and failure modes.
